text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yay... I won! I became a Derby 
Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the inspiring raceee!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
――But this isn't the end. I'll surpass 
Spe-chan... and next time, it'll be me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky was defeated by Special Week. 
The opinion of those around her naturally—

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Special Week was so strong...! At this 
rate, she's definitely gonna win the next 
one too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That girl's strength is the real 
deal. We gotta keep our eyes on Special 
Week from now on!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan really is popular, isn't she?
choice_data_list: Still, Sky was really strong too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But... I agree that Spe-chan still 
has plenty of room to grow.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I guess I gotta get even stronger by the 
Kikuka-sho~... Just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading toward the final leg of the 
Classic Triple Crown, the Kikuka-sho, 
summer arrives for the Umamusume.
